raw_description: Cylinder 1 Fuel Injector A Offset Learning At Min Limit
plain_explanation: The PCM applies a per-cylinder injector offset (Mengenausgleich) to compensate for production-tolerance differences in injector flow rate. Calibration code not programmed after replacement
symptoms: Misfire or rough idle on the affected cylinder
Possible fuel smell or smoke from exhaust

The module computes and cross-checks this value redundantly inside its own processor; when the results disagree, the code sets. Causes are an internal processor or memory fault, corrupted control-module software, or low or disturbed module supply voltage.

likely_causes: High DPF regeneration load with fuel dilution
recommended_action: Schedule service promptly and avoid hard driving until diagnosed.

raw_description: Low Pressure Fuel System Sensor Circuit
plain_explanation: The ECU detects a general fault in the low-pressure fuel system pressure sensor circuit. Without a valid signal the ECU cannot verify lift-pump pressure or fuel rail pre-pressure.
recommended_action: Schedule service promptly and avoid hard driving until diagnosed.

raw_description: Low Pressure Fuel System Sensor Circuit Range/Performance
plain_explanation: The signal of the low-pressure fuel sensor does not match the expected value during operation. Pressure does not rise as expected when the lift pump is commanded.
likely_causes: Sensor element aged beyond calibration window
recommended_action: Schedule service promptly and avoid hard driving until diagnosed.

raw_description: Low Pressure Fuel System Sensor Circuit High
plain_explanation: The low-pressure fuel system sensor signal voltage is above the upper limit. Either a short to reference voltage in the signal line, an open signal return, or a sensor reading pegged high after an internal failure. The HP-pump pressure-control strategy falls back to default.
likely_causes: Signal wire shorted to reference voltage
Connector pins corroded - high contact resistance
recommended_action: Schedule service promptly and avoid hard driving until diagnosed.

raw_description: Power Demand Signal Circuit

raw_description: Torque Management Request Input Signal A

raw_description: Torque Management Request Input Signal A Range/Performance

raw_description: Torque Management Request Input Signal A High

Typical causes are loss of power or ground at the module, an open or shorted CAN/LIN bus wire, a connector fault, or an internal module failure.
likely_causes: CAN wiring to secondary drive motor broken
Gateway module routing CAN messages incorrectly
symptoms: Affected modules may go into limp mode or shut down
Specific functions inoperative depending on module
Diagnostic tools may show communication faults

Left-side blind-spot monitoring stops working. Typical causes are loss of power or ground at the module, an open or shorted CAN/LIN bus wire, a connector fault, or an internal module failure.
likely_causes: Side radar damaged or covered (rear bumper hit)
Gateway module routing CAN messages incorrectly
symptoms: Affected modules may go into limp mode or shut down
Specific functions inoperative depending on module
Diagnostic tools may show communication faults
recommended_action: Safe to drive. Address at your convenience.

Typical causes are loss of power or ground at the module, an open or shorted CAN/LIN bus wire, a connector fault, or an internal module failure.
likely_causes: CAN wiring to disc player broken
Gateway module routing CAN messages incorrectly
symptoms: Affected modules may go into limp mode or shut down
Specific functions inoperative depending on module
Diagnostic tools may show communication faults
recommended_action: Safe to drive. Address at your convenience.
